y-m-13-11.title: Kana tikawedzera square, perimeter nearea zvinoitika sei?
y-m-13-11.topic: Hukama hwekuchinja kwecheivi ye square neperimeter nearea yayo

y-m-13-11.s.s1.hint.1: Isa mitengo yekutanga nemitengo mushure mekuwedzera padivi pedivi uye uwane kuti yakava ka kangani.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.a: Perimeter i ka2, area i ka4
y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.a: Wasimbisa nekuverenga kuti kana cheivi yawanzwa ka2, perimeter nearea zvinochinja nema multiple akasiyana.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.b: Perimeter i ka2, area i ka2 zvakare

y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.c: Perimeter i huwandu hwehurefu hwemativi 4. Wana kuti perimeter yekutanga ye 12cm inova mazana emacm mangani mushure mekuwedzera.

y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.d: Area inowanikwa nekuwanza kureba noupamhi. Tarisa zvinoitika kukureba noupamhi kana cheivi yawanzwa ka2.

y-m-13-03.title: Kana ukaisa mabracket, mhedzisiro ichachinja zvechokwadi here?
y-m-13-03.topic: Kuverenga kwakasanganiswa nema natural number: mabracket nekurongeka kwekuverenga
y-m-13-03.goal: Yedza chirevo che 'kuisa mabracket kunogara kuchichinja', tsvaga muenzaniso unopikisa iwe pachako, uye utsanangure mamiriro apo mhedzisiro isingachinji.
y-m-13-03.material: Jiho akati, 'Kana ukaisa mabracket mu expression, mhedzisiro inogara ichichinja.' Sua akapindura, 'Izvo zvechokwadi nguva dzose here? Ndinofunga pane nyaya dzisingachinji.' Vaviri vakasarudza kuenzanisa ma expression maviri vachishandisa nhamba nhatu a, b, c. Expression ㉮ ndi a + b × c (a kuwedzera b nguva c), uye expression ㉯ ndi (a + b) × c (kutanga verenga a kuwedzera b, wobva wawedzera ne c). Nhamba dzose nhatu ndenhamba dzakasikwa dziri 1 kana kupfuura, uye dzinoteerera kubvumirana kwekuti kuwedzera kunoverengwa pamberi pekuwedzera.
y-m-13-03.thinking.0: Kunzwisisa kuti muenzaniso mumwe haugoni kusarudza 'nguva dzose'
y-m-13-03.thinking.2: Kutaura mamiriro ekuti ishande kubva pazvakafanana mumienzaniso
y-m-13-03.prereq.0: Kubvumirana kuverenga kuwedzera nenzira yekuwedzera pamberi mu expression inosanganisa kuwedzera nekuwedzera
y-m-13-03.prereq.1: Kubvumirana kuverenga mukati memabracket kutanga kana pane mabracket
y-m-13-03.s.s1.prompt: Kana a=2, b=3, c=4, ㉮ ndi 2 + 3 × 4 = 14 uye ㉯ ndi (2 + 3) × 4 = 20. Unogona kutaura chii nezvemashoko evanhu vaviri kubva pamuenzaniso uyu mumwe?
y-m-13-03.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kuti 14 ne20 zvinoratidza mashoko aJiho here kana mashoko aSua.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti unoda muenzaniso wakadini kuratidza kuti 'inogara iri zvakadaro' hazvina kururama.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.o.a: Yakachinja kamwe, saka ndinogona kuva nechokwadi kuti mashoko aJiho akarurama kunhamba nhatu dzipi neipi.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.r.a: Wakatambanudza muenzaniso mumwe kunyaya dzose. Kuti utarise 'nguva dzose', unofanira kutarisa seti dzose dzenhamba nhatu.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.o.b: Mabracket haakanganisi mhedzisiro, saka mashoko aSua akarurama uye aJiho haana kururama.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.r.b: Wangoona muenzaniso wakachinja ne14 ne20. Tarisa kuti izvi zvinopikisana nemuenzaniso iwoyo here.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.o.c: Kana ndikachinja nhamba nhatu kakawanda zvakare uye zvose zvikachinja, mashoko aJiho anosimbiswa.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.r.c: Kuedza kakawanda hakufanani nekutarisa nyaya dzose. Pachine seti dzenhamba nhatu dzausati waedza.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.o.d: Mashoko aSua anogona kutariswa chete kana ukawana seti imwe kana kupfuura yenhamba nhatu apo makosha akaenzana.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.r.d: Unoziva kuti muenzaniso mumwe wakapesana unodiwa kuputsa 'nguva dzose'.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.explain: Muenzaniso mumwe haugoni kutarisa 'nguva dzose'. Kuti mashoko aSua akarurama here kunosimbiswa kana ukawana kunyangwe seti imwe yenhamba nhatu apo makosha e ma expression maviri akaenzana. Zvakapesana, kuratidza mashoko aJiho, waizofanira kutarisa seti dzose dzenhamba nhatu.
y-m-13-03.s.s2.prompt: Tarisa chirevo chaSua. Tsvaga nhamba nhatu (a, b, c) apo a + b × c ne (a + b) × c dzine kukosha kwakafanana, uye uzviise. Nhamba dzose nhatu ndenhamba dzakasikwa kubva ku1 kusvika ku20, uye peya inongochinjanisa nzvimbo dze a ne b (semuenzaniso, (1, 3, 2) ne (3, 1, 2)) inoverengwa semuenzaniso mumwe chete. Unoda mienzaniso 3 yakasiyana.
y-m-13-03.s.s2.hint.0: Chinja nhamba imwe chete pakati penhamba nhatu panguva imwe, nyora makosha e ma expression maviri, uye uratidze kana makosha akaenzana.
y-m-13-03.s.s2.hint.1: Unganidza mienzaniso apo ma expression maviri aiva nekukosha kwakafanana uye utsvage zvakafanana.
y-m-13-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba dzose nhatu dzinofanira kuva natural number kubva ku1 kusvika ku20.

y-m-13-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Chirevo chaJiho chakagadziriswa chakanyatsorurama kunyangwe pasina shoko 'nguva dzose' here?

y-m-13-01.title: Ndakadzima digit imwe ndokuwana mhinduro yakarurama

y-m-13-01.goal: Tarisa nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti kuwana mhinduro yakarurama kune fraction imwe hakusi hwaro hwekuti nzira yakarurama, uye ongorora kuti nzira iyi inovimbika zvakadini nekutsvaga ma fraction akarurama nechiitiko.
y-m-13-01.material: Kunyora fraction 16/64 (16 pamusoro pe64) nenzira nyore, Harin akadzima digit 6 inooneka mu numerator 16 ne denominator 64 zvose. Nema digit asara, numerator ndi1 uye denominator ndi4, zvichipa 1/4 (1 pamusoro pe4), uye 1/4 yakaenzana muhukuru ne16/64. Harin anoti, 'Kana ukadzima digit imwe chete, unogona kupfupisa fraction.' y-m-13-01.s.s1.line.2: 1/4 ne16/64 zvakaenzana muhukuru. Nekuti kana ukaparadzanisa 16 ne64 zvose ne16, unowana 1 ne4.
y-m-13-01.s.s1.line.3: Mhinduro yakabuda yakarurama, saka nzira ye 'kudzima digit imwe chete' inzira yakarurama zvakare.

Asi kuwana mhinduro yakarurama kune fraction imwe hakureve kuti nzira inogara yakarurama. Mutsara 5 unotambanudza mhedziso yemutsara 4 kuma fraction ose, saka une njodzi zvakanyanya. Muhanho inotevera, tinotarisa nekushandisa nzira imwe chete kune dzimwe fraction.
y-m-13-01.s.s2.prompt: Ngatishandiseyi nzira imwe chete ku12/21 (12 pamusoro pe21). 12 ne21 zvose zvine ma digit 1 ne2. (12/21 yakaenzana muhukuru ne4/7.) Sarudza chirevo chakakodzera.

y-m-13-01.s.s2.r.a: Wakavimba nemhedzisiro yekudzima sezvayakaita. Enzanisa chokwadi chekuti 12/21 inoenzana ne4/7 nemhedzisiro dzekudzima.
y-m-13-01.s.s2.o.b: 12/21 imusiyano chete nekuti ine chimiro chakakosha apo ma digit e numerator ne denominator akachinjanisirwa, uye nzira inogara yakarurama kuma fraction mamwe.
y-m-13-01.s.s2.r.b: Unobvuma musiyano mumwe asi uchiri kufunga kuti nzira inogara yakarurama. Wakatarisa kuma fraction mamwe here?
y-m-13-01.s.s2.o.c: Zvichienderana nedigit yadzimwa, inova 2/2 kana 1/1, uye zvose zvakasiyana muhukuru ne12/21, saka haisi nzira inogara ichishanda.

y-m-13-01.s.s2.o.d: Kana ukabvumirana kudzima digit 1 chete iri pa ones place ye denominator, inova 2/2, saka nzira iyi inova nzira yakarurama.
